claims.title: DESI DR2 BAO: hint of evolving dark energy
claims.title_zh: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡：暗能量演化的迹象
claims.statement: DESI DR2 BAO combined with CMB and type Ia supernovae prefers w0waCDM (w0 > -1, wa < 0) over LambdaCDM at 2.8-4.2 sigma depending on the SN sample.
claims.statement_zh: DESI DR2 重子声学振荡（BAO）数据与宇宙微波背景（CMB）和 Ia 型超新星结合后，相对 ΛCDM 更偏好 w0waCDM（w0 > -1，wa < 0），显著性为 2.8–4.2σ，取决于所用的超新星样本。

quantities.name: Delta chi2_MAP, DESI + compressed CMB prior
quantities.ours: -8.01 (reading B, omega_bc = omega_b + omega_c); -6.59 (reading A, with omega_nu)

quantities.name: Delta chi2_MAP, DESI alone / + Pantheon+ / + Union3

updates: 2026: DES-Dovekie SN recalibration lowers the DES-SN combination from 4.2 to ~3.2 sigma (Popovic et al., arXiv:2511.07517).
2026-07: DESI DR2 Lya full-shape gives 2.7 sigma (DESI+CMB) and 3.2 sigma (with SNe) (arXiv:2607.27410).
open_questions: How much of the preference comes from the w0-wa parametrisation versus binned w(z) or Gaussian-process reconstructions?
Leave-one-tracer-out and leave-one-SN-sample-out sensitivity of the signal.
claims.notes: Verified against arXiv abstracts in plan 002 (cosmology agent report, 2026-11-11). Milestone M1. Study 002 (2026-11-14): BAO-only and no-CMB rows reproduced, compressed-CMB row conditionally reproduced; full-CMB and DES-SN5YR rows are out of scope (full Planck/ACT likelihoods; 53.5 MB covariance above the download limit). The compressed prior reproduces when its omega_bc mean is read as omega_b + omega_c (-8.01) but not with omega_nu added (-6.59); the referee pointed out that the split may lie within the (unmeasured) theta_* calibration systematics, so the convention is left open (T-022). Study 002 R2-CAMB (2026-11-16): with theta_* from CAMB (anchored and raw) the R2 verdicts are unchanged (Delta chi2 shifts -0.002 to -0.125), so the split is robust to the theta_* calibration and R2 depends on the omega_bc convention itself, which only a primary source can settle. Referee (2026-11-16, post hoc, verified): the prior's source cmbant/PlanckEarlyLCDM gives omega_b + omega_c = 0.14143; DESI's 0.14208 adds omega_nu, so reading A is the faithful source prior and A gives about -6.6, not -8.0; how DESI's code applied the mean is open (T-030).

claims.title: The Milky Way's thick disk began forming ~13 Gyr ago
claims.title_zh: 银河系厚盘约 13 Gyr 前开始形成
claims.statement: Precise ages of ~250,000 subgiants (LAMOST x Gaia) show the old disk started forming ~13 Gyr ago, ~2 Gyr before the inner halo finished assembling, with a star-formation peak ~11 Gyr ago around the Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus merger.
claims.statement_zh: 约 25 万颗亚巨星（LAMOST × Gaia）的精确年龄表明，老年盘约 13 Gyr 前开始形成，比内晕完成组装早约 2 Gyr；恒星形成峰值约在 11 Gyr 前，与盖亚-香肠-恩克拉多斯（Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus）并合同期。

quantities.name: thick disk onset (mean age of the oldest bin)

open_questions: Robustness of the onset epoch to the isochrone grid.
claims.notes: Milestone M5. Updated catalog: 320,028 subgiants (NADC DOI 10.12149/101467); download only the needed columns. Study 010 (2026-11-16, published 247,104-row table): the 13 Gyr mean is reproduced on the catalogue's own age scale (12.93 Gyr), but the age-scale envelope (0.7-1.1 Gyr in quadrature) is comparable to the 0.87 Gyr margin to the Big Bang and a re-analysis 1.7 Gyr younger exceeds it; the 8 Gyr split and the old-disc sequence (span, 0.82 Gyr scatter) could not be determined, because the S15 selection term of our deconvolution is misspecified (referee, post hoc; re-test T-031). Lean: three gaps (bin identification, absolute scale, mean as onset).

claims.title: Dormant stellar-mass black holes found by Gaia astrometry

claims.statement_zh: Gaia 天体测量轨道加上视向速度（RV）后续观测，发现了绕普通恒星运行、无相互作用（不发生物质交流）的黑洞：BH1（9.6 M☉）、BH2（8.9 M☉）和 BH3（32.7 M☉）。

sources.cite: Gaia Collaboration, Panuzzo et al. 2024, A&A 686, L2 (Gaia BH3)

quantities.name: M_BH (BH3)
quantities.note: no DR3 orbit; paper table or DR4

quantities.name: El-Badry+24 NS candidates recovered by server-side screen

open_questions: Systematic DR4 screen of NSS orbits for dark companions > 3 Msun on release day (2026-12-02).
Does the NS-BH mass gap survive DR4 orbits?

claims.title: Binary black hole mass spectrum features (GWTC-4.0)
claims.statement: The BBH primary-mass distribution steepens above ~35 Msun with overdensities near ~10 and ~35 Msun (and a possible ~20 Msun feature); GW231123 lies in or across the pair-instability gap.
claims.statement_zh: 双黑洞（BBH）主星质量分布在约 35 M☉ 以上变陡，在约 10 和约 35 M☉ 处存在过密峰（并可能在约 20 M☉ 处有特征）；GW231123 落在对不稳定性质量间隙之内或跨越该间隙。

quantities.ours: 84 O4a exactly; 59 O1-O3 by the registered rule (the GWTC-2.1 rows of the ten O1/O2 BBHs carry no FAR on GWOSC); 69 and 153 post hoc with their GWTC-1 FARs

quantities.name: GW231123 total mass rank in the sample
quantities.ours: 236 Msun median, heaviest of 143 (153 post hoc)

open_questions: Robustness of the 35 Msun feature to pairing-function choices, using released summaries only.
claims.notes: Milestone M10. The population data release is 35 GB; use only the small files and the GWOSC event table. The ~20 Msun feature is only a hint.

claims.title: Hubble tension: local distance ladder vs early universe
claims.title_zh: 哈勃张力：本地距离阶梯与早期宇宙
claims.statement: Cepheid-calibrated distance-ladder H0 (~73 km/s/Mpc) exceeds the CMB-inferred LCDM value (~67-68) at >5 sigma; TRGB/JAGB calibrations (CCHP) give ~70.
claims.statement_zh: 造父变星定标的距离阶梯给出的 H0（约 73 km/s/Mpc）高于 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 值（约 67–68），差异显著性超过 5σ；TRGB/JAGB 定标（CCHP）给出约 70。

sources.cite: Riess et al. 2024/25, JWST validates HST distances

quantities.name: H0 SH0ES 2022 (GLS of the public matrices)
H0 shift, NGC 4258 only: 37 hosts -> 10 CCHP hosts (5 log H0)
H0 CCHP TRGB, 11 JWST calibrators, Pantheon+
Same host shift with a host-level random effect (REML tau 0.077 mag; 5 log H0)

open_questions: Is the CCHP-SH0ES difference a calibrator-host selection effect? (Study 003, post-data host labelling: in R22's data the CCHP hosts lower H0 by 0.073 +/- 0.033 mag in 5 log H0, and on those hosts Cepheids and TRGB agree to 0.01 mag; the host labelling was amended after the first run. The 2.2 sigma uses C-propagated errors; random 10-host subsets show 1.33 times more scatter, placing the CCHP set at the 4.7th-5.7th percentile, about 1.7 sigma empirically (the subset spread is itself uncertain), where the pre-registered table would read no significant effect.)
claims.notes: Milestone M2. Study 003 R2-RE (2026-11-16): with a host-level random effect estimated by REML (0.077 mag), the CCHP host shift is 1.5 sigma and the pre-registered table gives no host-selection effect detected; the random effect removes the excess random-subset scatter (spread 1.33 -> 1.005).

claims.title: Spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at z ~ 14 and the bright-galaxy excess
claims.title_zh: 光谱确认的 z ≈ 14 星系与亮星系过剩
claims.statement: JWST spectroscopy confirms luminous galaxies at z = 14.32 (JADES-GS-z14-0) and z = 14.44 (MoM-z14); the bright-end UV luminosity function at z > 10 exceeds pre-JWST model predictions.
claims.statement_zh: JWST 光谱确认了 z = 14.32（JADES-GS-z14-0）和 z = 14.44（MoM-z14）的高光度星系；z > 10 的亮端紫外光度函数超出 JWST 之前的模型预测。

quantities.name: log phi, z = 14-15, -21 < M_UV < -20 (N26, two sources)
observed / pre-JWST baseline
quantities.ours: constant-SFE model calibrated at z ~ 8 predicts 9.4x N26's baseline (2.5-37x across 72 variants), i.e. observed / ours ~ 19

open_questions: Minimal UV burstiness / star-formation efficiency needed at z ~ 12-15.
claims.notes: Milestone M8. Detection is established; the interpretation of the excess is contested. Study 006: the size of the excess depends strongly on the pre-JWST baseline (calibration-dependent across 72 model variants); the counts are two sources with Poisson errors only (cosmic variance, the effective area and the bin drawn around the detections are open gaps). The referee showed that 1 sigma in phi*, M* or alpha flips the sigma_UV verdict (phi* -1 sigma also brings the model within 3x of N26's baseline), and that a z ~ 8 dust correction raises the ratio and flips the sigma_UV verdict; follow-up T-025.

claims.title: Declining outer rotation curve of the Milky Way
claims.title_zh: 银河系外区旋转曲线下降
claims.statement: Gaia DR3-based rotation curves decline beyond ~15-20 kpc (about 30 km/s from 19.5 to 26.5 kpc), implying a lighter Galaxy (~2e11 Msun); the Keplerian interpretation is disputed.
claims.statement_zh: 基于 Gaia DR3 的旋转曲线在约 15–20 kpc 以外下降（从 19.5 到 26.5 kpc 下降约 30 km/s），意味着银河系质量较小（约 2×10¹¹ M☉）；开普勒式下降的解释存在争议。

quantities.name: M_dyn, six baryon models (Jiao 2023 Table 4)
quantities.ours: 1.969-1.980 e11 Msun (Einasto); an NFW halo, disfavoured (delta chi2 ~ 20) but not excluded, gives 7.1 e11

quantities.name: M_total (Jiao 2023)
quantities.ours: set by the Einasto shape: 99.8% of M_vir inside 26.5 kpc; V^2R/G(26.5 kpc) = 1.90 e11

open_questions: Joint propagation of Jeans-modelling systematics (cross-term, disequilibrium, disk scale length).

claims.title: Nanohertz gravitational-wave background from pulsar timing arrays
claims.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列探测到的纳赫兹引力波背景
claims.statement: NANOGrav, EPTA, PPTA and CPTA find a common red process with Hellings-Downs correlations at ~2-4.6 sigma, consistent with a GW background of amplitude ~2.4e-15 at f = 1/yr.
claims.statement_zh: NANOGrav、EPTA、PPTA 和 CPTA 发现了具有 Hellings-Downs 相关性的共同红噪声过程，显著性约 2–4.6σ，与 f = 1/yr 处振幅约 2.4×10⁻¹⁵ 的引力波背景一致。

sources.cite: Antoniadis et al. 2023, A&A 678, A50 (EPTA DR2)

quantities.name: A_GWB at gamma = 13/3 (NANOGrav, KDE refit v2.0.0, fiducial DMX noise model, median and 90%)
gamma, free power law (fiducial DMX noise model)
HPD level of gamma = 13/3 (2-D, fiducial DMX noise model)

open_questions: Is the SMBHB amplitude consistent with galaxy-merger and BH mass-function priors?
claims.notes: Milestone M9. Grade 'hint' here means strong evidence below 5 sigma. Study 005 refits the NANOGrav KDE free spectrum (Zenodo 21844115 v2.0.0; v1.1.0 = Zenodo 10344086 as a post-hoc comparison). The HD significance is not reproduced (needs the full timing data). The agreement is conditional on L8's fiducial DMX noise model: on the DMGP free spectrum (v1.1.0) the refit gives A = 2.19e-15 (Hellinger 0.31 to L8's interval) and the HPD level of gamma = 13/3 falls to 0.62 (study 005, post hoc).
